newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Notionnel in danger of drop below 129.02.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Notionnel in danger of drop below 129.02.

text.p: June notionnel futures run the risk of a decline below Wednesday's 129.02 low, which would signal a deeper short-term pullback, analysts said.
"Short-term the market looks a little bit toppy," said Simon Mattholie, proprietary trader at DBMG Futures and Options in London.
Mattholie said there was an hourly support line coming at 129.06. "The objective on the downside if we do take out yestesday's low is 128.20."
The June contract on the MATIF at 0724 GMT was at 129.20, six basis points up on the day.
Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London, also saw the market testing the downside.
"I would have thought it's more likely to see a bit of pressure on the support at 129.04, which was a buying area and 129.02, the day's low," she said.
Whitby said if those broke, the market would come back to 128.58, which she said was a buying level on June 3.
But Mattholie added, "The longer we stay in this 129.00-30 range, the less likely we are going to have a decline because it's just unwinding the overbought readings."
Whitby said if the market did try for the upside, which looked unlikely, it faced an overhead top at 129.60 and a 61.8 percent Fibonacci retracement of May's fall at 129.70.
